effect_description_eng:
[Hand] [Main] If you have a Digimon with [Justimon] or [Raidenmon] in its name in play, you may pay 1 memory to place this card under that Digimon as its bottom digivolution card.
[When Digivolving] You may trash 1 card with the [Machine] or [Cyborg] trait in your hand to suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 5000 DP or less. That Digimon does not unsuspend in your opponent's next unsuspend phase.
